name: lsingle_range_le_ker_lapply
statement: Set α) (h : Disjoint s t) : ⨆ a ∈ s, LinearMap.range (lsingle a : M →ₗ[R] α →₀ M) ≤ ⨅ a ∈ t, ker (lapply a : (α →₀ M) →ₗ[R] M)

name: exists_finset_of_mem_iSup
statement: Sort _} (p : ι → Submodule R M) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ⨆ i, p i) : ∃ s : Finset ι, m ∈ ⨆ i ∈ s, p i
